title: Fourier norm of the satisfied-term count
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. The Fourier one-norm of the function counting the terms of $\varphi$ satisfied by an input is at most the number of terms in $\varphi$.
